portal_hypertension.title: Transhepatic embolization of a pancreatico-duodenal arteriovenous malformation: Application of retrograde pressure cooker technique with ethylene-vinyl alcohol copolymer.
portal_hypertension.authors: Powanda PN, Rowland EA, Liu K
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：它们的管理具有挑战性，手术切除具有显着的发病风险。 临床提示：胰腺动静脉畸形是罕见的血管异常，可能表现为胃肠道出血、腹痛或门静脉高压。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Pancreatic arteriovenous malformations are rare vascular anomalies that may present with gastrointestinal bleeding, abdominal pain, or portal hypertension. Their management is challenging, with surgical resection carrying a significant risk of morbidity. Endovascular embolization offers a less invasive alternative; however, success is often limited in cases with multiple arterial feeders. We present a 65-year-old woman with cirrhosis and upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage from a Yakes type III pancreatic arteriovenous malformation. Given her poor surgical candidacy and complex arterial inflow, transvenous retrograde embolization via a transhepatic approach was performed using a modified press...

portal_hypertension.title: Drug-eluting Balloon Angioplasty as a Bridge to Early Liver Transplantation in Recipients with Coronary Artery Disease: A Case Series.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental hepatology
portal_hypertension.authors: Pakkala AK, Chaksota H, Patil S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：冠状动脉疾病 (CAD) 在终末期肝病 (ESLD) 患者中越来越受到重视，特别是在代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝病 (MASLD) 的背景下。 临床提示：药物洗脱球囊 (DEB) 血管成形术提供了一种“不留下任何痕迹”的方法，可以减少延长 DAPT 的需要，为早期肝移植提供潜在的桥梁策略。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Coronary artery disease (CAD) is increasingly recognized among patients with end-stage liver disease (ESLD), particularly in the context of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Management of CAD in liver transplant candidates is challenging due to the competing risks of ischemic events and perioperative bleeding, especially when dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) is required after coronary stenting. Drug-eluting balloon (DEB) angioplasty offers a "leave-nothing-behind" approach that may reduce the need for prolonged DAPT, providing a potential bridge strategy to early liver transplantation. portal_hypertension.title: Prediction of Fontan failure and correlates of Fontan-associated liver disease severity using machine learning and radiomic features from multi-parametric abdominal MRI.
portal_hypertension.authors: Prasad A, Opotowsky AR, Trout AT
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：Fontan 相关肝病 (FALD) 与姑息性单心室先天性心脏病患者的发病率和死亡率相关。 临床提示：使用 T1 加权、T2 加权和扩散加权 MRI 的放射组学特征以及相关临床变量来开发机器学习模型，以预测 Fontan 衰竭和患者 FALD 严重程度的相关性
portal_hypertension.abstract: Fontan-associated liver disease (FALD) is associated with morbidity and mortality in patients with palliated single ventricle congenital heart disease. To develop machine learning models using radiomic features from T1-weighted, T2-weighted, and diffusion-weighted MRI with pertinent clinical variables to predict Fontan failure and correlates of FALD severity in patients who underwent the Fontan operation. portal_hypertension.title: Post-Bleed Prognosis Beyond Hospitalization: The CLIF Consortium Acute Decompensation Score (CLIF-C AD) Predicts Six-Week Mortality After Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding in Patients With Cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Ciorba IM, Craciun Ciorba N, Bataga SM
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：目的 我们的目标是评估 CLIF 联盟急性失代偿评分 (CLIF-C AD) 的出血后风险分层，使用六周死亡率作为预先指定的主要终点，五天再出血作为预先指定的次要终点， 临床提示：背景 对于肝硬化，上消化道出血 (UGIB) 后的结果超出了住院治疗的范围。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Background In cirrhosis, outcomes after upper gastrointestinal bleeding (UGIB) extend beyond the index hospitalization.
